textocr_scoreboards.description: Real scoreboard and clock crops cut from Open Images photos (CC BY), with TextOCR's human transcriptions.

commons_scoreboards.description: Real scoreboard fields (scores, clocks, shot clocks, periods, fouls ...) cut from Wikimedia Commons photos of physical scoreboards, labelled field by field.

synthetic_7seg.description: Rendered 7-segment LED and LCD digits (scores, clocks, periods): a synthetic control set, not a measure of real-world accuracy.
